title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
lineage: AKG190E > Uher 400L MR; Audience master reel > (possibly one extra reel gen?) > modified Technics 1506 playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > CD > CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking > SHN

ai_review.summary: A solid early audience fragment that captures a legendary Fillmore show, highlighted by smoking Dark Star‑>The Other One improvisations.
ai_review.review: This partial AUD recording is surprisingly clear for its era and gives listeners a taste of the iconic November 8, 1969 performance. Reviewers rave about the show's energy—especially the extended Dark Star/Other One sequences—and note that the full concert shines on Dick’s Picks 16. While the fragment is short, its sound quality is good enough to make it worthwhile for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews praise the musical performance (many 5‑star comments) and consider the audience recording surprisingly good, yielding an overall high rating despite the fragmentary nature.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early audience tape praised for clarity ('gooood AUD') but only a brief fragment; no major drop‑outs reported, though limited in length.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon second set with seamless segues—Dark Star > The Other One > Dark Star > Uncle John's Jam > Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven > Caution > Main Ten Jam—showcasing deep improvisational flow.
